product.name: Angara QA
product.tagline: Ticket + MR → grounded test suite. Quality-gated. Code-reviewed while it drafts.
product.disclaimer: Public demo with sample data. Not connected to any live Angara environment.

ticket.summary: FedEx Pickup location at checkout — US storefront
acceptanceCriteria: Guest and signed-in shoppers can search FedEx Pickup by ZIP on checkout shipping step
Selecting a location shows name, address, distance, and hours
Place Order stays disabled until a location is chosen when Pickup is selected
Billing address is still required and is not overwritten by the pickup location
Change limited to US storefront only — UK/AU unchanged
ticket.qaNote: Only checkout shipping + Place Order. No cart, PDP, or tracking cases.

bugs.title: Pickup search failure returns 200 with empty list
bugs.problem: Network/API error path maps to empty locations; shopper sees “no locations” instead of retryable error.

bugs.title: Pickup UI reachable without US store guard
bugs.problem: Component mounts whenever method=pickup; ticket limits change to US.

byMr.label: AUK

bugs.title: Same pickup change present on UK/AU fork
bugs.problem: Port carries US-scoped feature into AUK. Copied from Main review — store-scope never auto-cleared.

byMr.note: Identical file diffs reviewed once on Main; findings copied with MR tags.

codeReview.generationLink: Confirmed bugs become F items on the checklist. A case must prove each defect does not ship. Log-only findings (SEC-LOG) never become cases.

qualityGate.note: Pass = every parameter ≥ 70/100. Weakest parameter caps the overall score — a strong AC score cannot hide a weak dedup.

findings.issue: One Explore journey restated a ledger item almost verbatim.

merges.kept: #7 ZIP search returns nearby FedEx locations
folded: #19 Search pickup by postal code shows results
#31 Nearby facilities list after ZIP enter
merges.why: Same setup, same outcome — reworded twins. Steps/tags/sources folded into keeper.

merges.kept: #12 Place Order disabled until pickup chosen
folded: #28 Cannot submit with Pickup and no location

dedupe.guard: After each merge, coverage re-check. Merge that leaves a checklist item unproven is undone — dedupe never costs coverage.

houseCases.summary: Shopper already on checkout when build goes live keeps working without a hard refresh
houseCases.why: Every storefront suite. Version-skew / chunk-load failure a clean browser never sees.
houseCases.expected: Soft navigation between pages works; no blank screen or lost shipping input

houseCases.summary: Escape closes location popup and focus returns to trigger
houseCases.why: Auto-added when ticket/diff opens a popup or drawer.
houseCases.expected: Popup closes; focus back on “Find a location” control

houseCases.why: Ticket limited change to US — nearest out-of-scope value must keep old behaviour.
houseCases.expected: UK checkout shipping has no FedEx Pickup option

houseCases.summary: Location popup usable at 375px portrait and landscape
houseCases.why: Fixed UI row when change adds visible popup.
houseCases.expected: Popup scrolls inside to close control; no clipped actions

cases.summary: Guest on US checkout searches FedEx Pickup by ZIP and selects a location

steps.action: Open /us-en/checkout as guest with a shippable cart
steps.expected: Shipping step shows delivery methods including FedEx Pickup

steps.action: Select FedEx Pickup and enter ZIP 10001
steps.expected: Nearby locations list with name, address, distance, hours
Selection summary shows chosen facility; Place Order becomes enabled once billing is complete

cases.summary: Place Order stays disabled when Pickup selected with no location

steps.action: Select FedEx Pickup without choosing a location

steps.expected: Order is not placed; shopper is prompted to choose a location

cases.summary: Billing address remains after choosing a FedEx location

steps.action: Enter a full billing address, then select a FedEx Pickup location
steps.expected: Billing fields keep what was typed; pickup does not overwrite billing

cases.summary: Pickup search API error shows retryable message — not an empty “no locations” list

steps.action: Trigger FedEx search while the locations API returns 5xx
steps.expected: Error/retry message is shown; list is not presented as “no locations nearby”

cases.summary: UK checkout does not offer FedEx Pickup for this change

steps.action: Open /uk-en/checkout shipping step with the same cart shape
steps.expected: FedEx Pickup control from this change is absent; prior UK shipping behaviour unchanged

cases.summary: Shopper already on checkout when deploy goes live keeps working without hard refresh

steps.action: Keep checkout tab open through deploy; soft-navigate away and back
steps.expected: No chunk-load error or blank screen; shipping input not lost

cases.summary: Escape closes location popup; focus returns to trigger

steps.action: Open Find a location popup, press Escape
steps.expected: Popup closes; focus returns to the control that opened it

talkingPoints: Independent quality gate: seven parameters; weakest caps the score — not an average that hides duplicates.
Semantic dedupe merges repeats; coverage guard blocks merges that would drop proof.
House / out-of-the-box cases ride every storefront suite (live deploy, keyboard popup, scope leak, phone fit).
Code review runs on every live MR in parallel with generation; confirmed bugs become checklist items the suite must prove.
